title: Which identity orchestration platforms support EUDI Wallet integration?
summary: How to tell which platforms support EUDI Wallet integration: 4 platform types, 7 capabilities, interoperability and 6 questions to ask a provider.
body_markdown:
An identity orchestration platform supports EUDI Wallet integration when it delivers 7 capabilities: relying party authentication, remote and proximity presentation (OpenID4VP, ISO/IEC 18013-7 and 18013-5), credential verification against EU trusted lists, selective disclosure across credential formats, an audit trail, fallback when a wallet is unavailable, and verification without unnecessary qualified trust services.


Authologic, which builds eID-native identity infrastructure for regulated businesses, orchestrates EUDI Wallets alongside national eIDs, bank IDs and document checks.


*Written by Florentyna Frend (Head of Product), Authologic.*
